mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_relation (tenant_id, parent_type, parent_id, parent_no, child_type, child_id, child_no, relation_type) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{parentType}, #{parentId}, #{parentNo}, #{childType}, #{childId}, #{childNo}, #{relationType}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, parent_type, parent_id, child_type, child_id, relation_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT child_type AS "childType", child_id AS "childId", child_no AS "childNo", relation_type AS "relationType", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM doc_relation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_type = #{type} AND parent_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at, id
